sections.title: Introduction & Use Cases
content: Adobe InCopy 2026 is a professional word processing program designed specifically for copywriters, editors, and proofreaders. The greatest power of InCopy lies in its seamless, deep integration with Adobe InDesign.

Historically, while a layout designer was actively working in InDesign, the editorial team could not touch the document. With the InCopy-InDesign collaborative workflow, designers and editors can work concurrently on the exact same project without overwriting each other's work.

sections.title: Understanding the User Interface (UI)

cards.title: Primary Tools Panel
cards.description: Located on the left edge by default, housing essential tools such as the Type Tool for copy editing, and Selection Tools for navigational control.

cards.title: Dynamic Control Panel
cards.description: Positioned at the top of the workspace, dynamically reflecting formatting options (typefaces, sizing, kerning, tracking, and leading) based on your active selection.
